samples.phenotyping_free: All women carried monoallelic protein-truncating germline variants (PTVs) in the CHEK2 gene. 557 of these were the c.1100delc mutation. Cases show individuals with breast cancer.

results.covariates: Year of birth, counselling center of origin
results.performance_comments: Only 81 of the original 88 SNPs  were used due to a call rate below 0.95 or significant association with c.1100delC carrier status. Of the 81 SNPs used, 7 were proxies R^2>0.8.
